gloss: medicine taken as needed; on-demand medication

definitions.gloss: medicine taken as needed; on-demand medication
definitions.explanation: Medication that is taken only when symptoms arise, rather than on a regular schedule.

examples.japanese: {痛|いた}いときに{頓服薬|とんぷくやく}を{飲|の}む。
examples.english: I take the as-needed medication when I'm in pain.

examples.japanese: {医者|いしゃ}に{頓服薬|とんぷくやく}を{出|だ}してもらった。
examples.english: The doctor gave me some medication to take as needed.

examples.japanese: この{頓服薬|とんぷくやく}は{一日|いちにち}に{三回|さんかい}まで{服用|ふくよう}できます。
examples.english: This as-needed medication can be taken up to three times a day.

notes:
{頓服|とんぷく} by itself means taking medicine on an as-needed basis, and {頓服薬|とんぷくやく} specifies the medication itself. Common examples include painkillers, sleep aids, and anti-anxiety medication. In medical contexts, this corresponds to the abbreviation PRN (pro re nata, Latin for "as the situation arises").

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {頓服|とんぷく}で{飲|の}む — to take (medicine) on an as-needed basis
- {頓服|とんぷく}{処方|しょほう} — as-needed prescription
- {痛|いた}み{止|ど}めの{頓服薬|とんぷくやく} — painkiller for as-needed use

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {常用薬|じょうようやく} — regularly taken medicine (the opposite: medicine taken on a fixed schedule)
- {市販薬|しはんやく} — over-the-counter medicine
- {処方薬|しょほうやく} — prescription medicine
